findings.reason: The 18 plotted duration labels on the paired panels match the medians of wall_seconds and recorded total_cpu_seconds in selected.tsv rows 2–28. Each bar uses the stated 55-second denominator.

The displayed shell-audit elapsed and accounted child CPU medians are 5.849 s and 3.253 s. The filter selected just those two rows and restored all 18. CPU counts reaped user and system time, including descendant accounting through waits, per fact-sheet.md.

Recalculation of all nine ratios as median total_cpu_seconds divided by median wall_seconds matches the display. Shell-audit warm 0.556, heavy-cli-build warm 0.559 and session-start warm 0.266 are child CPU seconds per elapsed second. Fact-sheet.md distinguishes that quotient from machine utilization or per-call attribution.

Selected.tsv row 3 records 0.712 user, 0.904 system and 1.615 total CPU seconds. Rows 14–19 and 26–28 record Go accumulated time as n/a. Fact-sheet.md supports the rounding, parallel accounting, and I/O caveats.
